saw_lines: Supplement buyers rarely commit on the first ad. They compare form, dose and taste, then reorder the same pack once it works.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the buyer sees a reason to switch packs.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so you should collect one real figure like review count or orders shipped and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has no reason to trust the claim. Collect one real number, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
0 of 17 copy ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers a first order offer or a bundle, and put it in the first line of three new ads.

29 ads have run 60+ days, which shows they work, yet the one newer ad does not reuse a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest video winner, the one opening on Nicht Kollagen.

Your 17 copy ads open with 14 different stories, and the biggest one opens only 2 ads. Spread that thin, no single angle gets enough repetition to learn from. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.
